title: Backend Engineer
description: Synthetic role: build dependable Python APIs backed by PostgreSQL. Explain transactions, request validation and operational diagnosis. Expected experience: at least 3 years of backend engineering; experience in another language can be transferable.
screening_criteria: Implement and test Python backend services.
Design PostgreSQL queries, indexes and transaction boundaries.
Design HTTP APIs with validation and explicit failure handling.
At least 3 years of backend engineering experience.

questions.text: Describe an API you owned and how you validated requests and represented failures.
Explain a PostgreSQL transaction or query problem you investigated.
Which backend responsibilities did you own, for how long, and how did you diagnose failures?

requirements.description: Implement and test Python backend services.
Design PostgreSQL queries, indexes and transaction boundaries.
Design HTTP APIs with validation and explicit failure handling.
At least 3 years of backend engineering experience.
Use service observability to investigate operational failures.
Computing qualification or equivalent documented engineering study.
